FN-B25UQ4J-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 207
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 207 as introduced would codify current practice of the Office of Information
Technology (OIT) coordinating IT procurement across agencies and oversight of computer and
telecommunications systems as provided by Act 2017-282. This bill would also provide for OIT
to oversee management of state government cybersecurity; $2,731,583 was appropriated in Act
2024-355 (General Fund Budget) for the purpose of cybersecurity for fiscal year 2025;
$2,926,615 was recommended by the Governor to be appropriated for fiscal year 2026.
